## Filed

### OOS_1: /implement orchestration robustness (combined)
- **Filed URL**: https://github.com/character-ai/larch/issues/3565
- Covers main-agent OOS_1 (scripts/parse-bootstrap-routing-envelope.sh aborts under set -e on already-populated routing keys) and OOS_2 (skills/review/scripts/review-core.sh dispatch-failed short-circuit bypasses the >50% reviewer-failure threshold), combined into one issue per combine-pass Rule A (related defects from one investigation).

## Rejected / Out-of-Scope Observations (not filed)

### OOS_3: FINDING_8 [OUT_OF_SCOPE] risk-integration (branch)
Rejected — ephemeral review-presentation nit: the branch diff shows unrelated larch-log / launcher-test commits, but the squash-merge collapses the branch to its net diff, so no durable follow-up work exists.

### OOS_4: FINDING_9 [OUT_OF_SCOPE] risk-integration scripts/design-pause-load.sh
Rejected — moot: #3529 (pause-load .pause-requested clearing) merged to main in 480c8ba4b before this PR; the docs/script revert-coupling risk it warns about is already resolved on main.
